headword: {完全予約制|かんぜんよやくせい}

definitions.explanation: A system where customers or visitors must make a reservation in advance and walk-ins are not accepted. Common for restaurants, clinics, salons, and specialty shops in Japan.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{完全予約制|かんぜんよやくせい}です。
examples.english: This restaurant is by appointment only.

examples.japanese: {完全予約制|かんぜんよやくせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦レストラン→レストラン：01048_resutoran⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{待|ま}ち{時間|じかん}→待ち時間：09621_machijikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: At reservation-only restaurants, there is no waiting time.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{寿司屋|すしや}→寿司屋：10166_sushiya⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{完全予約制|かんぜんよやくせい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、{一|いっ}か{月|げつ}⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{予約|よやく}しない→予約する：22989_yoyakusuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{入|はい}れない→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: That popular sushi restaurant is reservation-only, and you need to book a month in advance to get in.

notes:
USAGE:
Very common in modern Japan, especially for high-end restaurants, medical clinics, beauty salons, and specialty services. Often seen on signs, websites, and social media posts. Can be written as a sign or label.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {完全予約制|かんぜんよやくせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧ (a reservation-only establishment)
- {完全予約制|かんぜんよやくせい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{営業|えいぎょう}→営業：01878_eigyou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to operate on a reservation-only basis)
- {完全予約制|かんぜんよやくせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}する→変更する：30779_henkousuru⟧ (to switch to a reservation-only system)
